{{Top|leg}}
A '''guildmember''' was a [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] who was a member of a [[crafts-guild]]. The offspring of guildmembers were often bequeathed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] constructed by the guild in the hopes that the children, known as [[guild-apprentice]]s, would acquire the knowledge and skills to help them gain entry into the guild.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
